fact_check.claim: Cornell guarantees no housing to visiting scholars; they compete with grad students for Hasbrouck and Maplewood (Cornell Daily Sun, Nov 2024)
fact_check.note: Brief carries the Sun finding and Cornell's 'not guaranteed' wording.

fact_check.claim: International Scholar House: furnished 5-bedroom, month to month, since September 2023; price not published
fact_check.note: Brief row matches; brief also notes Cornell's own page does not mention it. The page attributes it to the Sun and marks price and how to apply as 'Not confirmed'.

fact_check.claim: Hasbrouck takes some visiting faculty and affiliates for temporary, academic-year or 12-month stays as space allows; contact gradhousing@cornell.edu; apply via the Housing application with grad instructions
fact_check.source_url: brief §2 (Visiting faculty and affiliate housing row)
fact_check.note: Wording matches the brief's quoted phrases.

fact_check.claim: Hasbrouck 2026-27 monthly rates: single $620, large single furnished $910, studio $1,355, 1BR furnished $1,490 (unfurnished $1,415), family 2BR 3rd floor $1,500, family townhouse $1,530 furnished / $1,475 unfurnished; 12-month contract
fact_check.note: All six values and the unfurnished figures match. 'Includes gas, electricity, garbage and internet' is not re-verified separately but page already states Cornell lists no separate temporary rate.

fact_check.claim: Hasbrouck units hold 2 to 4 people, no more than two adults; rolling applications
fact_check.note: Brief line 444 area carries both.

fact_check.claim: Maplewood: Greystar-managed, furnished, utilities included, private bath, in-unit washer/dryer, pets allowed; Vet College lists $1075-$1330, updated Feb 2026, basis not stated
fact_check.note: Page keeps the brief's caveat (per bed or per unit unknown) and marks shortest lease 'Not confirmed'.

fact_check.claim: Dryden South sublet: suites $1,395 per person, Fall 2026; furnished, heat and hot water included; 12-month leases ending May 31, 2027; 205 Dryden Road
fact_check.note: Same values and period.

fact_check.claim: Ithaca Renting downtown: median studio $1,395, 1BR $1,625, 12-month leases, mostly 2026-27
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Ithaca Renting Collegetown has 'Spring/Fall Semester 2027' rows, furnished, heat and hot water included; Foundation Housing Spring '27 roommate-matching leases
fact_check.note: Both named in brief.

fact_check.claim: Some visiting scholars get only $600 to $800 a month from home governments (a professor, Sun 2024)
fact_check.note: Attributed to a professor's statement in the Sun, same as the brief.

fact_check.claim: Sun reported family housing for visiting scholars as scarce with high upfront costs
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: RentCafe October 2026: Ithaca 2BR large buildings $2,459; 1BR $2,063
fact_check.note: Both values match. Page says 'large buildings', consistent with the brief's 50+ unit method note.

fact_check.claim: Deposit plus first month on a private 2BR is about $4,918 (our arithmetic)
fact_check.note: Recomputed: $2,459 x 2 = $4,918. Correct.

fact_check.claim: Six-month example: $1,395 x 12 = $16,740; six unused months = $8,370; Hasbrouck 1BR $1,490 x 6 = $8,940
fact_check.note: Recomputed all three: 1,395x12=16,740; 1,395x6=8,370; 1,490x6=8,940. Correct. Same $8,370 used in Common mistakes.

fact_check.claim: NY deposit plus advance rent cannot exceed one month's rent; application fees banned; background or credit check no more than $20; deposit returned with itemized list within 14 days
fact_check.note: Brief gives lesser of actual cost or $20 and the 14-day deadline.

fact_check.claim: Month-to-month: generally one month's notice; fixed lease that lapses continues month to month; after 30 days a tenant is removed only by formal notice and court case; oral lease over a year unenforceable; oral lease without term is at will
fact_check.note: All present in brief with Cornell Law guide sources.

fact_check.claim: Landlord duty to take reasonable steps to re-rent (RPL 227-E); sublet in buildings with four or more units needs consent not unreasonably withheld (RPL 226-B); unapproved sublet is a substantial breach
fact_check.source_url: brief §6 (227-E and 226-B rows, 'four or more', 'substantial breach')
fact_check.note: Matches brief.

fact_check.claim: City of Ithaca short-term rentals need a separate permit; Cayuga Heights rentals of 28 days or less need an annual permit under Local Law 2022-4
fact_check.source_url: brief §6/§8 (Cayuga Heights code office row; city permit row)
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: No SSN needed to rent an apartment (Cornell International Services); landlord disputes do not affect visa (Graduate School staff); tenant hotline (607) 301-1560, no income or geographic limits
fact_check.note: SSN quote and hotline match the brief. Visa/standing statement is attributed to Graduate School staff as in the brief's grad-tips row.

fact_check.claim: New degree students ride TCAT free in first year; PhD students and graduate assistants get free OmniRide; partner with CU ID can buy OmniRide student pass at 116 Maple Avenue; visiting scholars and postdocs not named (marked Not confirmed)
fact_check.note: Matches; the Not confirmed lines are honest holes.

fact_check.claim: Grad guide advises looking March to April for an August start
fact_check.note: Brief carries it.

fact_check.claim: Off-Campus Living: Marketplace needs proof of Cornell affiliation; email list needs a NetID, subject 'Join'; phone 607-255-2310
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Cornell advice that a one-year lease gives a certain amount of legal protection while a unit without a lease gives flexibility with limited protection
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Photo caption: North Campus from Thurston Avenue Bridge, before the bridge was rebuilt; CC BY 3.0, Notyourbroom
fact_check.note: Image license and the 'before rebuilt' detail were not re-opened; they belong to the image ledger and photo audit, not the brief. Does not affect the core answer.
